page.overview:
Who is Laizhu Bedenn?

Laizhu Bedenn was a female individual who was native to the planet Tatooine. In 4 ABY, she worked as a chef for Jabba in the kitchen of his palace after she was unable to pay her tithes to the Hutt. In the same year, she managed to escape alongside her friend Valnir Nai in a luxury speeder the two stole in the garage of the palace.
